description: This file defines functions to install Google Maps related custom fields and logic hooks for various modules in SuiteCRM, including Prospects, Leads, Contacts, Meetings, Opportunities, Cases, Projects, and Accounts. It sets up hooks for geocoding updates and manages custom field definitions for geolocation data.

methods.name: install_gmaps
methods.description: Main function to initiate Google Maps installation, installs custom fields and hooks.

methods.name: installJJWHooks
methods.description: Sets up logic hooks for various modules related to geocoding updates.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field definitions for geolocation data across multiple modules.
